editorial:
Imagine waking up and slowly realizing that you are forgetting the person you love most in the world. That is the scary reality for the couple in this story. A strange virus is spreading that wipes out your memories, and it is only a matter of time before it hits them. You get to see their struggle as they try to hold onto their bond while their pasts literally vanish. It feels very intimate and sad, focusing more on the feelings of the characters than on the science of the virus. It is a quiet, emotional ride that makes you think about what actually makes a relationship last.

The acting is the best part here because the leads make you feel every bit of their pain. The movie moves a bit slow, which might bore some people, but it helps you feel the sadness of their situation. If you like stories that tug at your heartstrings, you will love this one. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go. It is a great pick for a cozy night in with some tissues nearby.
endingExplained: By the end, the virus takes over and the couple loses almost everything they remember about each other. They end up as strangers who only have a vague feeling that they used to be in love. Even though their memories are gone, they decide to try and start over from scratch. It is a bittersweet ending because they lost their history, but they choose to love each other all over again in the present.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional dramas about love and loss.
